caption: The drawing depicts a single object that resembles a tall, lidded vessel or container, rendered in shades of black and grey on a cream-colored background. The object has a wide, circular base that tapers into a narrower stem before widening into a bulbous, vertical body. At the top, the container is covered with a dome-shaped lid, which flares outward at the edges. Attached to the top of the lid are two upright handles or prongs, slightly apart, and joined by a short chain that loops loosely from one handle to the other. The drawing is composed with visible, dense pencil or charcoal strokes that create dark, shaded areas and suggest a metallic or glossy texture. The entire subject is centered within a rectangular border outlined on the paper, which has some light discoloration along the edges. No additional objects, figures, or markings are depicted within the scene.
title: Lamp
